file.description: Audio or video file as a data URI (data:audio/...;base64,...), up to 25 MB. Provide exactly one of file or source_url.

source_url.description: HTTPS URL of an audio or video file for ElevenLabs to fetch, including YouTube and TikTok links. Provide exactly one of file or source_url.

language_code.description: ISO-639-1 or ISO-639-3 code of the main language (e.g. "en" or "eng"). Detected automatically when omitted.

tag_audio_events.description: Tag non-speech sounds such as (laughter) or (applause) in the transcript.

diarize.description: Label which speaker said each word (speaker_id).

num_speakers.description: Maximum number of speakers in the audio, up to 32. Helps diarization.

diarization_threshold.description: Higher values make one speaker less likely to be split in two. Only with diarize=true and no num_speakers.

timestamps_granularity.description: Timestamp detail in words[]: none, word (default) or character.

file_format.description: pcm_s16le_16 for raw 16-bit, 16 kHz, mono, little-endian PCM (lower latency); other (default) for any encoded file.

no_verbatim.description: Remove filler words, false starts and non-speech sounds.

keyterms.description: Up to 100 words or phrases (each up to 50 characters and 5 words) to recognise more accurately, such as names or jargon. Adds a per-minute surcharge.

temperature.description: Randomness from 0 to 2. Defaults to the model setting, usually 0.

seed.description: Best-effort deterministic sampling for repeated requests.

secondary_language_codes.description: Other languages that may be spoken alongside language_code, as ISO-639-1 or ISO-639-3 codes. Improves code-switched audio.

numbers_format.description: Write numbers as digits ("42") or words ("forty-two").
